713:t_003:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You want negotiations? Save that nonsense for your dreams!」

713:t_003:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Why should we gods speak to mere humans as equals?」

713:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You...! Do you still not understand the truth of life in this universe?!」

713:t_003:5.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We understand the principle of coexistence! That is why we gained power and attained eternity like this!」

713:t_003:6.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And we joined hands with $$皇帝ズール$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, who likewise became gods! We stand with the truth!」

713:t_003:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You have barely reached the threshold of $$シンカ$$! You have no right to speak!」

713:t_003:10.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「In fact, this universe has already eaten away at your hearts, infecting you with the disease called despair!」

713:t_004:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「All your bravado is useless! The despair in your hearts will devour your souls!」

713:t_004:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Humans can never defeat gods! Admit it!」

713:t_004:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up! Your words won't beat us!」

713:t_005:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm disappointed, $n. You failed to trust your friends, and despair took control of your heart.」

713:t_005:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Even if it lasted only an instant, that is powerful enough to halt your $$シンカ$$.」

713:t_005:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I have no strength... in my body or my heart...」

713:t_005:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「No... This is bad! Keep your souls strong! At this rate...!」

713:t_006:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I can't... hear $$バルゴラ$$'s voice...」

713:t_006:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What's wrong, $$リ・ブラスタ$$...?! Answer me!」

713:t_006:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is useless. You closed the path to $$シンカ$$ with your own hands.」

713:t_006:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have no interest in you anymore. Rot here.」

713:t_007:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He is different from before... He has... completely abandoned us...」

713:t_007:2.en:
$n
「Get a grip, Miss $$スズネ$$! He abandoned us? He's our enemy... the enemy of all humanity!」

713:t_007:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You sneaky $$御使い$$...! You slipped your presence into the gaps in their hearts!」

713:t_007:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「If we leave them like this, they may become $$真徒$$ too!」

713:t_007:5.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We will bury them here! Then the $$御使い$$ are next!」

713:t_007:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「We have to fight $$ミケーネ$$ and the army of darkness in this state...?!」

713:t_007:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「Is our battle... going to end here...?」

713:t_008:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I confirm that $$ミケーネ$$ and the army of darkness have been wiped out.」

713:t_008:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「At this rate, we will suffer defeat before long...」

713:t_008:3.en:
???
「Then I shall finish you off here.」

713:t_009:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$次元将$$ $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

713:t_009:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What do we do?! If we have to fight him in this state...!」

713:t_009:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it! We finally made it to the universe where they live, and now...!」

713:t_009:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You disappoint me, Earthlings.」

713:t_009:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The power you once possessed... $$真化融合$$...」

713:t_009:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That was our dream.」

713:t_009:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Here is your answer.」

713:t_010:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「What do you mean, this is the answer?!」

713:t_010:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$真化融合$$... That theory was proposed in our world as well.」

713:t_010:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But a theory was all it was... We could never reach that state.」

713:t_010:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$リヴァイヴ・セル$$ was developed as a substitute.」

713:t_010:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's the substance that creates $$次元獣$$s...!」

713:t_010:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$次元獣$$s forcibly fuse people and machines, using $$次元力|lc$$ to generate greater power...」

713:t_010:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So that is a form of imitation $$真化融合$$ too.」

713:t_010:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Your existence was the realization of our world's unattainable dream.」

713:t_010:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「At the same time, it invalidated everything we had done... our entire army of $$次元獣$$s.」

713:t_010:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It would be more accurate to say we are incompatible.」

713:t_010:13.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But the dream remained a dream. In the end, you relinquished that power yourselves.」

713:t_010:14.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will never lose to people like you!」

713:t_011:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「This power...! It's far greater than when we fought him in $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

713:t_011:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...Looking back, I have fought by forcing sacrifices on others all this time...」

713:t_011:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ soldiers forced to fight under orders, never told the circumstances...」

713:t_011:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$, who sought revenge for the loss of her father's life and $$ハイアデス$$' freedom...」

713:t_011:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$, who sought to strike down those distorting his clan's mission...」

713:t_011:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$バルビエル$$, who twisted his hatred and swore obedience to them even after they destroyed all his people...」

713:t_011:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$, ashamed of drifting between anger and resignation, who regained his will to live and his pride...」

713:t_011:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And the $$立ち上がる射手$$ $$リアクター$$ before me, who challenged the $$御使い$$ with an indomitable fighting spirit...」

713:t_011:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「By taking their lives, I gained the power of four $$スフィア$$s.」

713:t_011:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is why I must fight...! And I must win!」

713:t_011:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Earthlings... and $$リアクター$$s! Give me every last bit of your remaining power!」

713:t_011:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will surpass you and challenge the gods, to repay the lives I have taken!!」

713:t_012:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「With the power we have now...」
